issue.title: Cycler orders successor offers by localeCompare while Rust orders by PathBuf bytes, so mixed-case note paths number differently across engines
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-fb.4 (note #2, PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP), routed by the bob-cli-fb land agent.

The cycler's `successorOfferOrderCompare` (bob-plugins `plugins/task-status-cycler/src/085b-successor-offers.js:733`) breaks anchor/bullet ties by `String(notePath).localeCompare(...)` in both the keep_moving branch and the general branch. The Rust engine orders by `OfferOrderKey = (u8, (usize, usize), PathBuf, u8, usize)` (`src/native/task_complete/successors.rs:76`), and `PathBuf` compares raw bytes per component. The two orders disagree whenever the note paths differ only in case or punctuation, so the same close numbers offers differently in Obsidian than in `bob capture` / Bob Mac Capture. That breaks the §12.2 ORDER / KM22 "anchor then path" contract that both engines must share.

Repro (pure ordering, 2026-11-02):

    node -e 'const p=["projects/beta.md","projects/Zeta.md","projects/alpha_x.md","projects/alphaX.md"];
      console.log([...p].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b)).join(" "));
      console.log([...p].sort((a,b)=>Buffer.compare(Buffer.from(a),Buffer.from(b))).join(" "))'
    # localeCompare: projects/alpha_x.md projects/alphaX.md projects/beta.md projects/Zeta.md
    # bytes:         projects/Zeta.md projects/alphaX.md projects/alpha_x.md projects/beta.md

End to end: two project offer groups (or two keep_moving groups, KM22) sharing one anchor and bullet, from notes named like `Zeta.md` and `beta.md`. The cycler picker lists beta first and Rust lists Zeta first.

Pre-existing since bob-cli-7c.4 (bob-plugins 310739d, 2026-10-13) for every offer group. Keep-moving reused the comparator unchanged.

Fix direction: replace both `localeCompare` calls with a byte/code-unit comparison that matches Rust `PathBuf` ordering. For ASCII paths, a plain `<`/`>` comparison is enough. For non-ASCII paths, compare UTF-8 bytes per `/` component. Then add a mixed-case cross-engine vector to the successor tests in both repos.

task_type_fields.impact: Obsidian and bob capture/Bob Mac Capture number and order the same close's offers differently when tied groups come from notes whose paths differ in case or punctuation. Every offer group is affected, including keep_moving (KM22).
